changelog:
1.0.54.1 - Re-base onto upstream Omega 1.0.54 (release tag v1.1.12; 1.0.53/v1.1.11 skipped, same lineage). Upstream touched 10 of our 16 files. Three-way merged after normalising all sides to LF (Startup.xml was CRLF in our copy -- phantom-diff trap -- now LF). Startup.xml's KODIRDIL comment also carried a double hyphen inside an XML comment (illegal XML, rejected by minidom though TinyXML was lenient) - reworded, both fleets. Two real conflicts, both resolved by taking upstream and DELETING our overlay file because the reason for the patch is gone: (1) Defaults.xml -- upstream removed the Defaults_FauneFonts/Defaults_RobotoFonts/... font includes (Faune, Roboto-Black and Roboto-Regular-Linespacing fonts dropped from the skin) and moved font_plotbox/font_weather_small/font_overlay_plotbox/font_info_display inline into every fontset; our edit only swapped filenames inside those deleted includes. (2) DialogPlayerProcessInfo.xml -- upstream rewrote the 'Eotf&Gamut' label as 'EOTF and Gamut', which fixes the unescaped-ampersand parse error our overlay existed for. Font.xml merged clean but our four Hebrew fontsets still pulled the deleted includes, so they were rebuilt on the new skeleton: the two <include> lines replaced by the five inline fonts (incl. upstream's new font_mini_bold), using each set's own Hebrew regular/bold file with upstream's new sizes/linespacing. Includes_Views_Fallbacks.xml deleted upstream (renamed to Includes_Fallbacks.xml, which now holds only the Action_BuildViews/Action_BuildShortcuts stubs and no Exp_View_* re-definitions) -> our emptied overlay copy dropped, nothing to overlay. Exp_RipSource is STILL undefined in clean 1.0.54 -> our definition kept (Includes_Object). Kept and verified: GearsAI OSD button 7301, Flix visible-restriction removal (Includes_View), Startup factory defaults (HomeMultiNetflix + colorful icons), power-menu rows incl. "מה רואים הערב?" / "החלפת פרופיל" (Includes_Items), viewtype strings #31601-31611 (en_gb). he_il: dropped #31092 (Faune setting) and #31144, both removed upstream. script.skinhelper asset in v1.1.12 is still 0.0.4 -> our 0.0.4.1 PIL-less mod untouched.

1.0.51.29 - Define Exp_RipSource. Includes_Object.xml uses $EXP[Exp_RipSource] on the rip source badge but upstream never defines the expression (confirmed in clean 1.0.52), so every Home and video view load logged 'Misplaced ]' + 'Error parsing boolean expression [!skin.hassetting(textcodecs)] + []' (seen on Asaf's Shield, 2026-09-17) and the badge could never appear. Defined as a pure boolean from the exact conditions Image_RipSource resolves on (its filename tokens, or a non-empty FallbackSourceFlag), in the style of the skin's own expressions -- deliberately NOT String.IsEmpty($VAR[...]), which no skin we ship uses.
